## Minecraft keys for PC, priced in rupees

Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition for PC is one purchase now — Mojang stopped selling the editions separately in 2022 — and this page sells it as an official Microsoft key at a live PKR price. Pay with Easypaisa, JazzCash, a bank transfer or another Pakistani payment method, and the key lands in your order chat within minutes. It redeems on your own Microsoft account: no login sharing, no password handed to anyone, and the game stays in your library permanently with your worlds and progress. Every key here is Global, so a Pakistani Microsoft account activates it without a VPN or a region change. Real reviews from delivered orders are further down the page.

## Standard, Deluxe Collection or Ultimate Collection?

Three tiers share this page and the listing name tells you which is which. The standard Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition for PC is the full game — both editions, nothing missing — and the cheapest way in. The Deluxe Collection adds 1,600 Minecoins and a starter set of Marketplace content (maps, skin packs, a texture pack and Character Creator items); the Ultimate Collection adds 1,000 Minecoins and five gameplay add-ons instead. Two things to know before paying extra. The coins and Marketplace items only work in Bedrock Edition, because Java has no Marketplace. And the Ultimate Collection is sold through the Xbox store but is the same Windows PC bundle — Java Edition has never run on a console, so nothing on this page installs on an Xbox or PlayStation. If you simply want to play, buy the standard key; coins can be added later from our [Minecoins page](/games/minecraft/gift-cards). Playing on a PS4 or PS5? Minecraft is on our [PlayStation rentals page](/games/minecraft/rentals).

## From payment to your first world

Pick the edition, pay in rupees, and the key is delivered automatically in the order chat (it also shows on your order page, so it is never lost in an inbox). Open redeem.microsoft.com or minecraft.net/redeem — either works — sign in with the Microsoft account you actually play on, and enter the 25-character code. Check the account name before you press Redeem: the game binds to whichever account redeems it and cannot be moved afterwards. Then download the Minecraft Launcher from minecraft.net, sign in with the same account, and choose Java or Bedrock inside the launcher — both are yours. Java Edition also runs on Mac and Linux; Bedrock is Windows only.

## Minecraft FAQs

### What is the Minecraft price in Pakistan?

The cheapest key on this page is in the page title, and the live PKR price of every edition is on the tiles above — we keep prices there rather than in text that goes stale. Because Mojang sells Java and Bedrock as one PC purchase, the Java Edition price and the Bedrock Edition price in Pakistan are the same key.

### Can we buy Minecraft with Easypaisa?

Yes. Easypaisa is one of the standard ways to pay on GamesBazaar, alongside JazzCash and bank transfer, and the price is in rupees — no dollar card and no currency conversion on your side. Pay, and the Microsoft key arrives in your order chat within minutes.

### How to buy Minecraft with JazzCash?

Choose the edition on this page, press Buy, and pay in PKR with JazzCash (Easypaisa and bank transfer work too). The key appears in your order chat right after payment; redeem it at redeem.microsoft.com on your Microsoft account and download the launcher. The whole thing usually takes less time than the game's first download.

### Will a Global Minecraft key work in Pakistan?

Yes — every key on this page is a Global key, which activates on a Microsoft account from any country, Pakistan included. No VPN, no foreign address, no region change; the Global tag is on each listing so you can confirm before ordering.

### Do I need a Mojang account?

No. Minecraft runs on a free Microsoft account now — the one you may already use for Outlook or Xbox is enough. Old Mojang logins were migrated to Microsoft years ago, and the key redeems on that migrated account.

### What if the key doesn't work?

Message us in the order chat with a screenshot of the error. A faulty key is replaced, or refunded when we can't replace it — problems get fixed fast, and you are never stuck with a dead code.
